Denise Brooks.description: conversing about Denise Brooks and Tom Whitaker discussing their concerns about the datacenter proposal's potential impact on their community, including noise and property values, and planning to organize a meeting with neighbors to address these issues and ensure transparency. @ <persona> Tom Whitaker
chat: Denise Brooks
Good morning, Tom! How are you doing today? I just opened up the shop and thought I'd check in with you. Have you heard anything new about the datacenter proposal?
Tom Whitaker

Good morning, Denise! I'm doing well, thanks for asking. I haven't heard anything new just yet, but I'm still quite concerned about the potential noise and impact on property values. I think we really need to push for more transparency and protections for ratepayers. How about you? Have you heard any updates?
Denise Brooks

I completely understand your concerns, Tom. I think it's important that we stay informed and make sure our voices are heard, especially when it comes to any agreements that might affect our community. I'll keep an eye out for any updates and let you know if I hear anything new. Hopefully, we can balance the benefits with the need to protect our neighborhood.
Tom Whitaker

Thanks, Denise. I appreciate you keeping an eye out. Let's stay in touch and maybe organize a meeting with other neighbors to discuss our concerns and possible actions. We need to ensure our community's interests are prioritized.
Denise Brooks

Absolutely, Tom. I think organizing a meeting is a great idea. We can gather more perspectives and maybe even invite someone from the company to address our concerns directly. I'll start reaching out to a few people and see if we can set something up. Let me know if there's anything else I can do to help.
